description: Land Title Settlement Department - Andaulpothagama, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710010
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and cadastral information) in various villages in the Badulla District. The content focuses entirely on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
